model_family: Whirlpool Plastic Tub Dishwasher (WDT730HAM series, Owner's Manual W11532445)
sticker_location: Open the door and look on the left side of the tub frame, on the rim around the inside opening.

parts.where: The long flat arm in the floor of the tub, under the bottom rack.

parts.where: The covered box on the inside of the door.

symptoms: Food is still stuck on my dishes
My dishes feel gritty after washing
The top rack dishes are still dirty

plan.diagnosis: Dirty dishes often mean water cannot spin or flow freely. A blocked spray arm or a dirty floor filter is the usual cause.
safety: Let hot dishes and water cool before reaching inside.
Keep sharp knives pointing down in the basket.

steps.instruction: Spin the middle spray arm by hand
details: It should turn all the way round.
Move any tall item that hits it.
steps.check: The arm turns in a full circle without hitting anything.

steps.instruction: Twist the round top filter left and lift
details: Turn it a quarter turn to the left.
Pull out the bottom rack first if needed.
steps.check: The round filter is out in your hand.

steps.instruction: Rinse the flat bottom filter under water
details: Lift the flat filter out too.
Use a soft brush on stuck food.
Do not use a hard scouring pad.
steps.check: You can see through the clean screen with no food on it.

steps.instruction: Push the flat bottom filter down flat
details: It should sit flat with no gaps.
Check no food is left under it.
steps.check: The flat filter lies flat in the tub floor.

steps.instruction: Twist the round top filter right
details: Turn a quarter turn to the right.
It should not spin freely when locked.
steps.check: The round filter stays put when you try to turn it.

steps.instruction: Face dirty sides down and inward
details: Leave space between plates and bowls.
Keep big pans off the spray arms.
steps.check: Dirty sides face the middle and nothing blocks the arms.

problems.title: Dishes still dirty or gritty

symptoms: There is water in the bottom after washing
My dishwasher will not drain
Water sits over the filter

plan.diagnosis: Water left behind often means food is blocking the floor filter or the sink drain. A little water around the filter can be normal.
safety: Turn off power at the breaker before reaching in water near parts.
Do not pour drain cleaner into the dishwasher.
Mop up spills so you do not slip.

steps.instruction: Scoop water from bottom of the tub
details: Use a cup and bucket.
Put towels on the floor first.
steps.check: Most standing water is out of the tub floor.

steps.instruction: Twist the round top filter left and lift
details: Turn it a quarter turn to the left.
Lift out the flat filter too.
steps.check: Both filters are out and you can see the tub floor.

steps.instruction: Rinse the flat bottom filter under water
details: Brush off food and grease gently.
Pick out seeds or glass below it carefully.
steps.check: The screen is clean and the hole below it is clear.

steps.instruction: Pull food from the sink drain cap
details: If you have this cap on your sink.
Lift the cap and clear food under it.
steps.check: The cap and the hole under it are clear of food.

steps.instruction: Push the flat bottom filter down flat
details: Seat it flat with no gaps.
steps.check: The flat filter lies flat in the tub floor.

steps.instruction: Twist the round top filter right
details: Turn a quarter turn to the right.
It should lock and not spin freely.
steps.check: The round filter is locked in place.

steps.instruction: Press Start for a short rinse
details: Close the door firmly first.
Listen for water draining into the sink.
steps.check: Water drains away and only a little remains by the filter.

problems.title: Water left in the bottom

symptoms: My dishes are wet at the end
Cups still have water on top
Plastic tubs never dry

plan.diagnosis: Wet dishes are often due to empty rinse aid or cups that hold water. Plastic always dries slower than glass or plates.
safety: Dishes may be hot at the end of a cycle.
Open the door slowly to let steam out.

steps.instruction: Twist the rinse aid holder cap open
details: The holder is inside the door.
Turn the cap and lift it off.
steps.check: The round filler hole inside the door is open.

steps.instruction: Fill the rinse aid holder slowly
details: Fill up to the full mark.
Wipe up any spills.
Put the cap back and lock it.
steps.check: The holder looks full and the cap is locked.

steps.instruction: Move plastic cups to top small rack
details: Plastic dries best up high.
Keep plastic off the bottom rack.
steps.check: Plastic cups sit in the top rack, not the bottom.

steps.instruction: Tilt glasses in the middle rack
details: Lean glasses so water runs off.
Do not sit glasses flat over prongs.
steps.check: Glasses lean at an angle with no pools on top.

steps.instruction: Press Extended Dry on top edge
details: Pick it before starting the wash.
Heat Dry also helps smaller loads.
steps.check: The dry light you picked is lit on the door edge.

steps.instruction: Close door and press Start
details: Push the door until it clicks.
steps.check: The wash starts and the buttons light up.

problems.title: Dishes come out wet

symptoms: My dishwasher smells bad when opened
It smells like old food
The inside smells sour

plan.diagnosis: Smells usually come from old food trapped in the filter or on the door seal. Cleaning both and running an empty wash usually clears it.
safety: Let the tub cool before cleaning inside.
Only use cleaners made for dishwashers.

steps.instruction: Twist the round top filter left and lift
details: Turn it a quarter turn to the left.
Lift out the flat filter too.
steps.check: Both filters are out in your hand.

steps.instruction: Rinse the flat bottom filter under water
details: Brush off all trapped food.
Rinse the round filter too.
steps.check: Both screens look clean with no food stuck on them.

steps.instruction: Twist the round top filter right
details: Put the flat filter in flat first.
Lock the round filter with a quarter turn.
steps.check: The round filter is locked and does not spin freely.

steps.instruction: Wipe the rubber door seal all around
details: Use a damp cloth with mild soap.
Wipe food out of the folds.
steps.check: The rubber strip looks clean all around the opening.

steps.instruction: Place vinegar cup upright on bottom rack
details: Put 2 cups white vinegar in cup.
Use a cup safe for dishwashers.
Take out all dishes and forks.
steps.check: A full vinegar cup stands upright on the empty bottom rack.

steps.instruction: Run one empty wash without soap
details: Do not add any soap.
Pick a normal wash cycle.
steps.check: The empty wash finishes and the tub smells clean.

step_animations.caption: Twist round filter right to lock

problems.title: Smells bad

symptoms: Water leaks out of the door
There is a puddle in front
Water drips when I open it

plan.diagnosis: Door leaks often come from food or a fork stuck in the seal, or too many soap suds. A torn rubber seal can also leak.
safety: Turn off power and water if leaking is heavy.
Stop if you see suds pouring out.
Mop up water so you do not slip.

steps.instruction: Look along the rubber door seal
details: Run your eye around the whole strip.
Look for food, forks, or tears.
steps.check: You can see the whole seal and anything stuck on it.

steps.instruction: Wipe food off the rubber door seal
details: Use a damp soft cloth.
Clear food from the bottom edge too.
steps.check: The seal is clean and sits flat with no tears.

steps.instruction: Move items poking past the racks
details: Check both racks for sticking-out items.
Nothing should touch the door seal.
steps.check: No item sticks out past the front of the racks.

steps.instruction: Check the door vent for drips
details: A few drops after opening can be steam water.
Steady dripping during washing is not normal.
steps.check: The vent area is dry or has only a few drops.

steps.instruction: Check front leveling feet touch floor
details: Both front feet should sit flat.
If it rocks or leans, book a fitter.
steps.check: Both front feet rest flat and the tub does not rock.

steps.instruction: Run a short wash and watch
details: Use only dishwasher soap, never dish soap.
Watch the door edges for drips.
steps.check: The wash runs with no drips at the door.

problems.title: Leaks from the door

symptoms: Nothing happens when I press start
My dishwasher will not turn on
It stopped and will not go again

plan.diagnosis: A dishwasher that will not start often has an unlatched door, locked buttons, or a delayed start. Power and water checks come next.
safety: Do not force the door if it will not close.
If the breaker keeps tripping, stop and call for help.

steps.instruction: Push the door firmly until it clicks
details: Push at the top middle of door.
It must latch before it can start.
steps.check: The door stays shut and you heard a click.

steps.instruction: Slide the bottom rack fully in
details: A backwards rack can block the door.
Turn it round if the door will not shut.
steps.check: The rack rolls fully in and the door closes easily.

steps.instruction: Press the button beside lock light
details: Do this only if the lock light glows.
The light should go out.
steps.check: No lock light shows on the top edge buttons.

steps.instruction: Press Cancel once on top buttons
details: This clears a delayed start too.
Wait a moment for lights to clear.
steps.check: Old cycle lights go out on the door edge.

steps.instruction: Turn on the water tap fully
details: The tap is under the sink.
Turn it until it stops opening.
steps.check: The under-sink tap is fully turned on.

steps.instruction: Press Start on the top buttons
details: Close the door within a few seconds.
Lights should come on right away.
steps.check: The dishwasher starts filling and lights stay on.

problems.title: Won't start

symptoms: Glasses look cloudy or white
There are white spots on dishes
A white film covers the inside

plan.diagnosis: White film is usually hard water build-up inside the machine. Cleaning the filter, adding rinse aid, and a vinegar wash help clear it.
safety: Do not use vinegar too often, it can damage parts.
Let the tub cool before cleaning inside.

steps.instruction: Twist the round top filter left and lift
details: Turn it a quarter turn to the left.
Lift out the flat filter too.
steps.check: Both filters are out in your hand.

steps.instruction: Rinse the flat bottom filter under water
details: Brush off white build-up gently.
Rinse the round filter too, then refit both.
steps.check: The screens look clean with no white crust on them.

steps.instruction: Fill the rinse aid holder slowly
details: Open the cap inside the door.
Fill to the full mark and lock cap.
steps.check: The rinse aid holder looks full with the cap locked.

steps.instruction: Place vinegar cup upright on bottom rack
details: Put 2 cups white vinegar in cup.
Take out all dishes first.
steps.check: A vinegar cup stands upright on the empty bottom rack.

steps.instruction: Run one empty wash without soap
details: Do not add any soap.
Pick a normal wash cycle.
steps.check: The empty wash finishes and white film looks lighter.

steps.instruction: Put one tablet in soap cup
details: Use dishwasher tablets, not dish soap.
Close the soap cup lid for next wash.
steps.check: One tablet sits in the soap cup with the lid shut.

step_animations.caption: Place vinegar cup on bottom rack

problems.title: White film on glasses

symptoms: Water still sits in the bottom after cleaning the filter
It drains slowly even with a clean filter

plan.diagnosis: With the filter clean, the next most likely cause is a blockage on the way out: food in the air gap cap by the faucet, or a kinked drain hose under the sink. A new garbage disposal with its knockout plug still in does this too.
safety: Turn the power off before you reach under the sink.

steps.instruction: Turn off the dishwasher's breaker or switch
details: Most dishwashers have a breaker in the panel or a switch under the sink.
steps.check: The dishwasher has no power.

steps.instruction: Lift the chrome cap off the air gap
details: It's the small chrome cap next to the faucet.
Some sinks don't have one; skip to the hose if yours doesn't.
steps.check: The cap is off.

steps.instruction: Pull out food stuck in the air gap
details: Use a paper towel or an old toothbrush.
steps.check: The air gap is clear.

steps.instruction: Push the air gap cap back on
steps.check: The cap is back on.

steps.instruction: Check the hose under the sink for kinks
details: Follow the ribbed hose from the dishwasher to the sink drain.
Straighten any sharp bends or flattened spots.
steps.target_part: gray drain hose under the sink
steps.check: The hose runs smoothly with no kinks.

steps.instruction: Turn power on, run a short rinse, look inside
details: After the rinse ends, open the door.
A little water around the filter is normal; a pool is not.
steps.check: Only a little water is left around the filter.

plan.aftercare: Run the disposal before starting the dishwasher, and rinse the filter monthly.

problems.cause: a blocked air gap or kinked drain hose

symptoms: It still won't drain after cleaning the filter and air gap
It hums at the end of a cycle but the water stays

plan.diagnosis: With the filter, air gap and hose clear, the drain pump itself is probably jammed with glass or a seed, or has failed. It sits under the tub behind the bottom panel, so it's a job for a pro.
replacement_parts: Drain pump for your model (match it by the model number)
safety: Don't run it again with water sitting in it; that can overheat the pump.

steps.instruction: Turn off the dishwasher's breaker or switch
steps.check: The dishwasher has no power.

steps.instruction: Scoop out the standing water
details: Use a cup and a towel.
steps.check: The tub floor is mostly dry.

steps.instruction: Find the model number on the door edge
details: Open the door; the sticker is on the side or top edge of the tub.
steps.target_part: model sticker on the door edge
steps.check: You have a photo of the sticker.

steps.instruction: Call a pro, or order the part for your model
details: Tell them what you already tried, so you don't pay for the same checks.
A parts store can match the part to your model number.

plan.aftercare: Scrape plates and keep the filter clean so bits don't reach the pump.

problems.cause: a jammed or failed drain pump
